integrity: Two standalone exact Python verifiers independently reconstruct the 240 exceptional-curve classes and all 22 Frobenius flag signatures; all numerical counts in the result are asserted by replayable code.
scientific_limitations: Requires a smooth degree-one del Pezzo surface with a Frobenius-stable reduced general-position eight-point blow-up marking in characteristic at least five.
The theorem classifies possible Frobenius cycle partitions but does not assert fieldwise realizability of all types.
Counts are setwise Galois-stable incidence flags, not rational points of line intersections or Picard/Brauer torsion.
Older unindexed E8/S8 permutation-character tables may contain an equivalent arithmetic count.
title: One-field reconstruction of the Frobenius octad type from degree-one del Pezzo exceptional-curve flags
